The '''Hands-Free Comlink''' was a model of [[headset comlink]] manufactured by [[VargeCorp/Legends|VargeCorp]]. It cost one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and had a voice-activated [[Microphone/Legends|microphone]] transmitter.<ref name="PSG" />
